methods.name: flame.model-provider/call.v1
methods.description: Execute one original provider exchange using the captured client and preserve its complete outcome.

methods.name: flame.model-provider/close.v1
methods.description: Retire the captured client after its accepted calls have joined.

methods.name: flame.model-provider/count.v1
methods.description: Count the complete request using the same captured provider instance, only when that capability was advertised.

methods.name: flame.model-provider/embed.v1
methods.description: Execute one original embedding exchange and preserve the complete provider response.

methods.name: flame.model-provider/open-chat.v1
methods.description: Capture one immutable provider client shared by chat, streaming and optional token counting.

methods.name: flame.model-provider/open-embedding.v1
methods.description: Capture an immutable embedding client and its vector-space identity.

methods.name: flame.model-provider/profiles.v1
methods.description: Read this installed adapter's provider policies and published model facts.

methods.name: flame.model-provider/remote-models.v1
methods.description: Read model identities from the exact configured provider endpoint.

methods.name: flame.model-provider/reopen-chat.v1
methods.description: Reconstruct a fresh client from the original confirmed open receipt, without reading current credentials or authorizing generation.

methods.name: flame.model-provider/stream.v1
methods.description: Stream the original provider deltas and retain the final outcome without replaying an unconfirmed exchange.

methods.name: flame.model-provider/verify.v1
methods.description: Prove the exact configured connection authenticates with its provider.
